description: Search the foundations that have a public GrantCue profile (built from the latest Form 990-PF, or Form 990 Schedule I for community foundations and other grantmaking charities), largest givers first. Search by name, city, state or EIN, by the state they mainly give to, or for those that publish how to apply. Form 990 grantmakers are found by name, state or EIN, after the 990-PF matches, each marked source_form "990". Returns 10 per page.

accepting_applications.description: true: only foundations whose latest filing publishes how to apply.

page.description: Page of 10 results. Only the first 10 pages can be reached.

query.description: A foundation name, the city or state it is based in, or its 9-digit EIN.

recipient_state.description: Foundations whose giving goes mostly to this state (two-letter code), like the state lists on the foundations pages.

name: search_funders
title: Search foundations
